candidates.name: CAVCO INDUSTRIES, INC.

checks.title: Consistent profits
checks.explain: 10 years of results, 0 with a loss. Buffett wants a long, unbroken record of earnings.

checks.title: High return on equity
checks.explain: Profit earned on shareholders' money: a sign of a durable advantage.

checks.title: Pricing power (gross margin)
checks.explain: High gross margins suggest a moat: customers pay up for the product.

checks.title: Net profit margin
checks.explain: How much of each sales dollar ends up as profit.

checks.title: Positive free cash flow
checks.explain: Cash from operations after capital spending: Buffett's 'owner earnings'.

checks.title: Earnings backed by cash
checks.target: Free cash flow ≥ 80% of net income
checks.explain: Reported profits should turn into real cash.

checks.title: Conservative debt
checks.explain: Buffett favors companies that could pay off debt from a few years of profits.

checks.title: Low capital needs
checks.explain: Businesses that don't need heavy reinvestment free up cash for owners.

checks.title: Growing earnings per share
checks.explain: Steady per-share earnings growth over the years available.

checks.title: No heavy share dilution
checks.explain: Issuing lots of new shares (often stock pay) shrinks each owner's slice.

candidates.verdict_text: Quality business, but 0% above the buy-below price. Wait for a better price.
